budgets.limit: One reconciliation service owns mapping, remark replay, preparation status and idempotent internal-order creation.
One domain guard owns mutable-plan versus immutable-fact decisions; parsers and controllers cannot mutate fulfillment facts.
Each configuration tab owns one user-facing responsibility; shared identifier and catalog selectors contain no page-local API calls.
Extract before a new or materially changed production source exceeds 450 physical lines.
One ordered forward migration plus an explicit rollback strategy; no historical migration file is edited.

forbidden_shortcuts: No identifier fallback between XianGuanJia and Xianyu fields.
No product default fallback for multi-SKU products.
No frontend authoritative matching or schedule calculation.
No production backfill or third-party write during Development.
